name: Suspension Fallout
steps: Face away from the anchor, hold the handles at hip height and lean forward until the straps are taut.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes tightly so your entire body forms a rigid straight line.
Reach forward and overhead with straight arms, letting your body incline as a unit within the range you can control.
Pull forcefully downward through your lats and abs to return your straight arms back in front of your chest.
tips: Stop leaning out immediately before your lower back begins to sag toward the floor.
Step slightly farther forward from the anchor point to reduce intensity or farther back to make it harder.
